rules.comment: iOS/Android reference repos cloned via scripts/clone-refs.sh
Mutable iOS/Android back-port working clones (see docs/ios-backports.md)
Files that must be downloaded from the Internet (package-lock.json is written by `npm install`)
Test golden files — archived/restored separately via archive-golden/restore-golden
Regenerated every build or derived from other files

notes.fallback: Any file tracked by git (git ls-files) and not matched by an explicit rule above is category 3. An untracked file that git ignores is NOT category 3 — it needs an explicit rule here, or an entry in `ignore`; file-manager.sh reports it as uncategorized.
notes.dist: dist/ and dist.zip are build output (category 1), not tracked by git. Built output reaches users only as the dist.zip archive attached to a GitHub release.
